title.zh: 授权菲律宾总统依据美国第454号公法（通称《菲律宾共和国军事援助法》）与美国政府缔结一项或多项协定，并颁布必要规则与条例以实施该法，且规定违反该法的处罚的法案
title.en: An Act to Authorize the President of the Philippines to enter into an agreement or agreements with the Government of the United States pursuant to United States Public Act Numbered Four Hundred and Fifty-Four, commonly called the "Republic of the Philippines Military Assistance Act," and to issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement said act, and providing penalties for violations thereof

title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền cho Tổng thống Philippines ký kết thỏa thuận với Chính phủ Hoa Kỳ theo Đạo luật Công cộng Hoa Kỳ số 454, thường gọi là 'Đạo luật Hỗ trợ Quân sự Cộng hòa Philippines', ban hành quy tắc và quy định cần thiết để thực thi đạo luật này và quy định hình phạt đối với vi phạm
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจประธานาธิบดีฟิลิปปินส์เข้าทำข้อตกลงหรือข้อตกลงหลายฉบับกับรัฐบาลสหรัฐอเมริกาตามกฎหมายสาธารณะของสหรัฐอเมริกาฉบับที่สี่ร้อยห้าสิบสี่ซึ่งมักเรียกกันว่าพระราชบัญญัติความช่วยเหลือทางทหารสาธารณรัฐฟิลิปปินส์และออกกฎระเบียบและข้อบังคับที่จำเป็นเพื่อดำเนินการตามพระราชบัญญัติดังกล่าวรวมทั้งกำหนดบทลงโทษสำหรับการฝ่าฝืนพระราชบัญญัตินั้น
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pemberian Wewenang kepada Presiden Filipina untuk Mengadakan Perjanjian atau Perjanjian dengan Pemerintah Amerika Serikat berdasarkan Undang-Undang Publik Amerika Serikat Nomor 454 yang umumnya disebut sebagai 'Undang-Undang Bantuan Militer Republik Filipina', serta mengeluarkan peraturan dan ketentuan yang diperlukan untuk melaksanakan undang-undang tersebut dan menetapkan sanksi atas pelanggarannya
title.ms: Akta Memberi Kuasa kepada Presiden Filipina untuk Mengadakan Perjanjian atau Perjanjian dengan Kerajaan Amerika Syarikat berdasarkan Akta Awam Amerika Syarikat Nombor 454 yang biasanya dipanggil 'Akta Bantuan Tentera Republik Filipina' dan mengeluarkan peraturan serta perintah yang diperlukan untuk melaksanakan akta tersebut serta menetapkan hukuman bagi pelanggarannya

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_9_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to enter into agreement or agreements with the President of the United States, or with any of the agencies or instrumentalities of the Government of the United States, regarding military assistance to the armed forces of the Republic of the Philippines, in the form of transfer of property and information, giving of technical advice and lending of personnel to instruct and train them, pursuant to the provisions of United States Public Act Numbered Four hundred and fifty-four, commonly called the "Republic of the Philippines Military Assistance Act," under the terms and conditions provided in this Act.

The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary and comparable to those customarily made by the United States, for the security of any article, plan or information received or acquired under the terms of this Act.

Any officer, employee or agent of the Republic of the Philippines who shall, directly or indirectly, permit the use of any property received under the provisions of this Act or shall disclose any plan, specification or other information pertaining thereto, or any technical information furnished, for any purpose other than as set forth in the United States Public Act Numbered Four hundred and fifty-four or who shall violate the security of any plan or information received under the terms of this Act shall be punished as provided in the Articles of War (Commonwealth Act No. 408) or in Espionage Law (Commonwealth Act No. 616) or with imprisonment for not more than ten years or a fine of not more than ten thousand pesos, or both, in the discretion of the court, whichever of said penalties is higher.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 2, 1946
